user.title: Add Yutai Wi-Fi socket
user.description: Enter the device IPv4 address and 32-character MiIO token. Setup only reads device identity and properties. Supported model: yutai.plug.jdls1.

reconfigure.title: Update socket connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the token blank to keep the current token. The authenticated device identity must remain the same.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid device IPv4 address.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot verify the device. Check the address, token and local network access.
error.unsupported_model: This model has no verified profile and cannot be added.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different device. Add it as a separate socket.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device identity does not match this configuration.

command_failed.message: The power command could not be confirmed. The socket may have changed state; check it before retrying.
